experimental_unit: one fixed freshstack query embedded raw and with the candidate instruction

controlled_variables.index: exp 22 baseline index held fixed (preserved at ~/Development/DATA/omrg/experiments/exp22-lancedb); the query instruction deliberately does not participate in index identity (task 4.8)
controlled_variables.retrieval: hybrid (BM25 + dense, RRF k=60), rerank disabled, top_k 50

validity_gates.metric: paired mean lift of recall_at_5 vs raw
validity_gates.basis: smallest lift that clears the paired bootstrap 95% noise floor (half-width 0.024838); a 0.02 lift sits inside noise and a pass there could be luck. Absolute equivalent: mean R@5 >= 0.2859 against baseline 0.255884
baseline 0.278862 minus paired bootstrap 95% half-width 0.020571; an instruction preamble dilutes identifier tokens, taxing exact-token recall first
1.5 x baseline p95 1984.2 ms; clears the baseline p95 estimator CI upper bound 2334.3 ms. Latency is cloud-inclusive; candidate and baseline runs must be interleaved to control network drift

monitored_non_gating.reason: bootstrap 95% half-width is 0.15 at n=20 (gate_noise.json); any hard gate would be noise, so continuity is recorded and inspected, not gated
